evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Champion governance, documentation, and quality standards
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Governance, quality standards, documentation, and reliability dominate the responsibilities with no velocity/speed language present.
evidence.domain_risk: help some of the world's biggest retailers and consumer goods brands make smarter decisions through data
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Retail/CPG analytics affecting commercial decisions (availability, waste, sales) without regulatory or financial-reporting consequence places it at moderate risk.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Behind this is a growing Data & Analytics team that transforms complex data into meaningful commercial insights
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing, growing Analytics function with named tools (dbt, Snowflake/Databricks) and a mentoring responsibility over other analytics engineers indicates a mid-maturity, actively scaling team.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design and maintain scalable data models using dbt and SQL...Build and maintain trusted semantic layers and metric definitions
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Specific named tools and precise scope (semantic layers, metric definitions, AI agents) give a clear picture of daily technical leadership work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Partner closely with our Customer Success teams to ensure we fully understand the business problem we're looking to solve through data
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Customer Success is explicitly named as the primary partnering function, and the business itself sells commercial retail insights to clients.
evidence.autonomy_level: you'll act as a technical leader within the Analytics function, driving best practices and helping the team evolve how we work with data
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Strategic verbs dominate ('shape', 'drive best practices', 'champion', 'mentor'), positioning this as a technical-leadership, direction-setting role.
evidence.ai_role: Explore and implement AI-powered analytics solutions, including automated insight generation and AI agents
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to build AI-ready analytics solutions and AI agents that are downstream consumers of the data infrastructure, an ai_enabler signal (also mentions AI tool usage as a nice-to-have, but the dominant responsibility framing is building AI-consuming infrastructure).
evidence.testing_framing: An understanding of governance, lineage, version control and data quality frameworks
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Quality standards and governance are framed as something the candidate champions and owns as part of the role, not just a listed tool.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Improve the performance, efficiency, and reliability of analytics workflows
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Moderate framing — reliability and governance matter for trusted commercial insights, but there is no compliance, audit, or regulatory risk language.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Improve the performance, efficiency, and reliability of analytics workflows...Design and maintain scalable data models
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role focuses on maintaining, improving, and scaling an already-established data and analytics function rather than building from zero.
evidence.work_arrangement: Enjoy a hybrid work model (typically 2 days in the office) with flexibility based on business needs, plus a work from anywhere policy
evidence.loss_aversion: Improve the performance, efficiency, and reliability of analytics workflows — moderate reliability framing without explicit compliance or regulatory risk language.
